talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 47 solo PCPs winding down in Alabama; 6 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Gadsden 35901, Montgomery 36106, Selma 36701) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~8,423 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Blount County, Henry County, St. Clair County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 27 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~121,200 patients across 101 at-risk practices statewide.
